Subject: Airwall release acceptance and signer rotation logistics

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the artifact bundle and checklist overnight; attached is our acceptance manifest (nle_airwall_manifest_v2.json) and a short list of questions before we sign off the physical transfer: 

- Can Redwood confirm the signer roster (names + contact numbers) who will attend the depot handoff?
- We need the signer public key fingerprints and whether signing was performed with customer-dedicated HSM keys or Redwood-managed KMS.
- Preferred courier windows: Jun 21-23 (PST) — can you confirm availability and PoA for the courier?

We want to schedule a brief 30-min readiness call (operations + security) before the courier departs.

Thanks,
Erin Holt
Sr. Infrastructure Manager
NorthLake Energy

Hi Erin — thanks for the manifest and the clear checklist. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

- Signer roster: we will provide the full signed roster by EOD tomorrow. Initial expected attendees: Marcus Lin (Ops lead), Ben Carter (Field engineer), and a Redwood compliance witness (Kimberly Park). I will confirm direct numbers.
- Keys: the release bundle was signed by Redwood’s customer-specific signing key stored in our HSM (YubiHSM-backed key in our custody partition for NLE). We will export fingerprints; the signature file is attached (signed_manifest_v1.sig).
- Courier windows: Jun 22 (preferred) with a 09:00–13:00 acceptance window. SecureCourier has prelim availability — I’m looping Ben to confirm routing and PoA templates.

Proposed cadence:
1) Readiness call: Tue Jun 15 10:00 PT (30m) — operations + security.
2) Signer roster & fingerprints: deliver by Tue EOD.
3) Courier booking: Ben to confirm by Wed Jun 16.

I’ll also attach our on-site acceptance checklist and a short rollback plan for the canary activation.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachment: signed_manifest_v1.sig (signature)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Erin Holt <erin.holt@northlakeenergy.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Airwall release acceptance and signer rotation logistics

Erin / Aisha — looping in a couple operational details that will matter at handoff: 

- Packaging: the release will be delivered as an encrypted, signed tarball plus the signed manifest. At the depot we perform a blind integrity check (SHA256) before operator keys are unsealed. We will provide the SHA256 sums in the final courier packet.
- Canary window: we recommend a 2-hour canary activation on the first node only, followed by a 6-hour observation period before cluster-wide promotion. If any regression detected, we have a scripted revoke and rollback (operator-run rollback script + manifest revocation).
- Courier & PoA: SecureCourier requires a signed PoA form for pickup; I’ve attached the draft PoA we use for sealed deliveries. Please confirm signatory names and authorized pickup location.

I will confirm SecureCourier routing and send the tracking manifest once booked.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Field Delivery Lead, Redwood Inference
attachment: redwood_poA_draft.pdf (pdf)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Erin Holt <erin.holt@northlakeenergy.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Airwall release acceptance and signer rotation logistics

Thanks — a couple security asks before we finalize the roster and courier schedule: 

- Key ceremony evidence: NLE requires an attestation that the signing key was generated in an HSM and that the private key never left the module. We will produce a key-ceremony log snippet and HSM audit statements to include in the release package.
- Signer rotation timing: to reduce blast radius we recommend performing Redwood-side signer rotation 72 hours before the physical handoff, then publish new fingerprints to NLE. That gives NLE Ops time to validate before acceptance.
- Chain-of-custody form: use the attached key_escrow_template.docx as the baseline; NLE legal will likely redline. Please confirm whether NLE wants Redwood to witness the signer keywrap ceremony on-site or accept remote notarized logs.

I can join the readiness call — please confirm dial-in.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
attachment: key_escrow_template.docx (docx)

- Readiness call set for Tue Jun 15 10:00 PT (we attended). Good notes from Ben and Kim.
- NLE prefers Redwood to perform signer rotation 72 hours prior and to provide HSM export fingerprints + attestation logs. Remote notarized logs are acceptable if the on-site disclosure is constrained.
- Courier: SecureCourier booking confirmed for Jun 22, pickup 08:30 PT from Redwood depot 4. Please send final PoA and final SHA256 sums no later than Jun 20 17:00 PT.

Signatory roster for NLE acceptance (please send direct numbers):
- Marcus Lin (Redwood Ops)

We will circulate internal PoA and location details to our facilities team after we receive the final packet. Thanks — looking forward to the handoff.

Best,
